title: [review] provisioning.py:435: Max sessions check before expi
description: The check `len(self._sessions) >= self._max_sessions` at line 435 happens BEFORE `_expire_sessions()` is called at line 440. If all sessions are expired but not yet cleaned up, new session creation is incorrectly rejected. This allows a DoS where an attacker opens max_sessions connections, lets them expire, and the resource is permanently stuck refusing new sessions until manually restarted. The fix is to call `_expire_sessions()` before checking the session count.
close_reason: Fixed: moved _expire_sessions() call before max_sessions check in both create_br_session and create_node_session methods. Added SECURITY comments explaining the DoS prevention rationale. All 23 provisioning tests pass.
